title: catalog.item_created v1
description: Emitted when a catalog item is persisted (CREATE) in alebrije-mod-catalog-go. Real producer in prod: the transactional outbox (cmd/server/integration.go wires WithOutbox when EVENTBUS_URL is set, k8s/deployment.yml EVENTBUS_URL). service.go CreateItem writes outboxItemPayload (internal/service/outbox_publisher.go) into catalog.outbox in the same tx as the write, and the poller relays it as this ADR-31 envelope inside the stream field `payload` (internal/service/outbox_poller.go). data = outboxItemPayload: item_id, tenant_id, sku, name, item_type, occurred_at. The direct RedisPublisher path (internal/service/redis_publisher.go itemPayload, used only without an EventBus: local dev and unit tests) XADDs the same body flat; validators wrap it in the equivalent envelope (same rule crm-go uses for direct XADDs of enveloped schemas). Consumer: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex MirrorEventConsumer (decodes payload -> envelope -> data). Until 2026-11-12 this schema was FLAT and described only the dev path; the prod wire never matched it (ADR-186 §10.4, audit of the catalog envelope-validation lane).

item_id.description: UUID of the created catalog item (it.ID.String(), redis_publisher.go:214).

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit code, unique per tenant (it.SKU, redis_publisher.go:216).

item_type.description: Catalog entry kind (it.ItemType, redis_publisher.go:218; models.go:78 discriminates product | analyte | profile | package). Left as a plain string rather than an enum: models.go's comment and ingestion.go's IngestType* constants list overlapping-but-not-identical value sets, so constraining here risks a future valid value being fail-closed rejected once validation activates (008).

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the outbox row was written (outboxItemPayload). Only the outbox path sets it; the direct RedisPublisher path (local dev, no EventBus) does not, so it is optional.
